theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξs : ℕ → Euclid P → MultiVector P d) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P d) (Ts Ts' : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U d) (T T' : GeometricCurrentOn U d), Continuous g → (∀ j, μs j {x | g x < s} < ∞) → μ {x | g x < s} < ∞ → (∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (ξs j) (μs j)) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ j, ∀ᵐ x ∂(μs j), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) d, |ξs j x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) d, |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ (j : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn U d), Ts j ω = ∫ x, ξs j x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂(μs j)) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U d, T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ) → (∀ (j : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn U d), Ts' j ω = ∫ x in {x | g x < s}, ξs j x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂(μs j)) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U d, T' ω = ∫ x in {x | g x < s}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ) → WeaklyConvergesOn Ts T → (∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ᶠ j in atTop, μs j {x | s - δ ≤ g x ∧ g x ≤ s} ≤ ε) → WeaklyConvergesOn Ts' T'
